behavior: Commit a private resource binding only after both fresh network and volume validate; no container proceeds after interrupted creation.
Require stable network identity/creation, local-volume creation/mountpoint and actual component resource references during execution.
Independent watchdog permits only an empty precommit window bounded to90seconds, latches the committed binding and rejects loss/change/foreign network membership.
Abort preserves foreign resources and uses existing run/component/name-checked shutdown; no network, volume or Desktop deletion/stop.
limits: Daemon metadata, namespace behavior, volume replacement and host/guest time assumptions are modeled and require a separately reviewed native run.
Local volumes have no immutable Docker Id; metadata binding is not attestation against a daemon administrator.
Native SSO/MFA/rotation/browser behavior and remaining mandatory gates are not complete.
